name: Thailand
dek: Bangkok Metropolis, WMO 48455. The capital, not the islands.
paragraphs: The reference station is Bangkok Metropolis, WMO 48455, height 3.01 m. Phuket, Chiang Mai, and the islands are not this table; the Thai submission has many station files, and none were averaged.

The highest average high in the table is 35.7 °C, in April. The lowest average low is 23.2 °C, in December. The wettest month by the precipitation column is September, at 335.9 mm, and the driest is December, at 11.6 mm. No official tipping source was found on this pass, so that line is missing.

climate.caption: Reference station: Bangkok Metropolis, WMO 48455. Not a national average.
climate.note: World Meteorological Organization 1991–2020 climatological standard normals, distributed by NOAA NCEI. Monthly values are copied as printed, with leading spaces removed; a value printed with no leading zero, such as -.3, is shown as -0.3. Don Muang Airport (48456) and Bangkok Port Klong Toei (48454) are separate Bangkok files and were not averaged in. Some values are printed without a decimal place, such as 33, and are shown that way.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: The Tourism Authority of Thailand newsroom guide for tourists and foreigners says: "Drive on the left side of the road."
driving.sourceTitle: TAT Newsroom, Driving in Thailand: Essential Guidelines for Tourists and Foreigners

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Thailand, last reviewed October 08, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Baht and the code THB for Thailand.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Thailand one row, Asia/Bangkok. zone1970.tab lists that zone on a row it shares with Christmas Island, Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam; the zone name is the same in both files.

bestTime.intro: Month by month for Bangkok, from the station table above and the three seasons described by Thailand's Land Development Department: the rainy (southwest monsoon) season from mid-May to mid-October, winter (northeast monsoon) from mid-October to mid-February, and summer (pre-monsoon) from mid-February to mid-May. The same page says the east coast of southern Thailand runs on a different calendar, with heavy rain into the end of the year and November its wettest month, so this is not an islands guide.

months.note: Winter season. Average high 32.7 °C, low 23.4 °C, 23.6 mm. The Land Development Department says December and January are quite cool in upper Thailand.

The rainy season starts in mid-May. Average high 35.1 °C, low 26.9 °C, 216.8 mm.
Rainy season. Average high 34.1 °C, low 26.4 °C, 198.5 mm.
Rainy season. Average high 33.5 °C, low 26.1 °C, 189.7 mm.

Rainy season. Average high 33.2 °C, low 25.4 °C, 335.9 mm. The wettest month in the Bangkok table.
The rainy season ends and winter begins in mid-October. Average high 33 °C, low 25.2 °C, 288.7 mm.
Winter season. Average high 33.1 °C, low 24.7 °C, 44.6 mm, a drop of about 85 percent from October.
Winter season. Average high 32.3 °C, low 23.2 °C, 11.6 mm. The driest month and the lowest average low in the Bangkok table.
